resources.string: This conversation still has running tasks and cannot be archived directly. Confirm whether to stop them before archiving.
Move this conversation to the archived list and make it read-only. Its history will not be deleted, and you can restore it later.
Archiving hides a conversation without deleting its history. Restore it from the archived list.
This conversation is still running. Archiving requests that active tasks stop and makes the conversation read-only. Its history will be kept. Continue?
This conversation is archived and read-only.
Live connection paused in background; resumes when you return
The system clipboard is unavailable. Open the full document, or select the text and try copying again.
The new conversation may have been created, but this could not be confirmed. Refresh the conversation list and check before creating another. Your draft is kept.
Remove pending item from this device only
Enter a question or attach images, PDFs, and other documents. Ask follow-up questions, or open a generated scene in the lab to explore it.
Unable to read or save conversation data on this device. Check storage and try again.
You do not have permission to access this conversation or perform this action.
The network connection was interrupted. Check your connection, then reconnect to verify the conversation and sending status.
This conversation is missing or no longer accessible. Refresh the conversation list.
The conversation data format could not be read. Reconnect, and send feedback if the problem persists.
Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
The conversation service could not complete this action. Try again later.
Enter a question or follow up…
The message exceeds 200,000 characters. Shorten it before sending.
Import limit per file: %1$d MiB. Images per message: up to %2$d, totaling at most %3$d MiB.
This reply was interrupted and may be incomplete.
Showing the local cache. Sending messages, downloading attachments, and updating the conversation require a connection.
This is an abbreviated preview. Open the document to read all content.
Accepted by server — awaiting conversation confirmation
Removed from the local pending list
The server did not accept this message
The queued message has changed or may already have been processed. Refresh before trying again.
Request removal of this unprocessed queued message. Content already in the conversation history will not be deleted.
Move this conversation back to the unarchived list so you can ask more questions. Stopped tasks will not restart automatically.
Checking the server snapshot and message history. Available content will appear when recovery is complete.
Reconnect and check the latest conversation before retrying this message.
Opening this loads the full scene for interaction in the lab, not just a screenshot.
Offline search filters cached conversation titles only. Full history search requires a connection.
More matches are available. Use more specific keywords to narrow the results.
No conversations match the current filters
Sign in to continue. If already signed in, verify your session again.
This generation was blocked and the reply could not be completed.
An error occurred during generation. The reply may be incomplete.
This generation was interrupted. Check the existing content before asking a follow-up question.
The output length limit was reached. The reply may be unfinished.
The server may already have received this message. Retrying checks the latest conversation first and reuses the same request ID to avoid duplicate delivery.
This conversation includes events this app version cannot display. Some content may be missing from the view.
